_note: The eight built-in skin gradients as v10.6.0 shipped them, before the 10.6.1 redesign re-rolled every SKINS[].glow. Kept verbatim so tests/client.smoke.test.cjs can RECOMPUTE the migration fingerprint from the real bytes instead of trusting the literals in lib/client.js -- a hand-copied constant once silently disabled the factory-wallpaper migration on every machine and no test could tell, because every other case rewrote the triple to fit its own synthetic payload. Extracted from `git show v10.6.0:lib/client.js` (`const suggestions = {...}`).
